title: 與Apple Health數據連線不良
body: 不記得何時開始，無法自動連結Apple Health的睡眠數據，使用者每天手動紀錄一個不準確的數字有意義嗎？希望能盡速檢測並改善，謝謝
author: Rxxee

title: Good interface. Hope can add visualized progress on calendar, like other apps
body: As title. If you add a function in long-time tracking, not only for a bar chart but also chart on calendar ( reference: daily habit), I will definitely buy this app because it has  customized goal.
author: Zoealien

title: Statistics
body: 介面和顏色的設計很棒！但統計圖表的部分覺得可以再加強，畢竟付費版的金額也不低。統計的部分希望可以看到一整年達成的次數用日曆的方式呈現，以及針對每一個個別的goal可以有看到一年達成的次數而不是只有%。
author: Chiau18

title: Growth bundle failed
body: Bought the yearly growth bundle plan. Doesn’t work. Other apps are still locked behind a paywall. Emailed developers- responses were slow and unhelpful. Then they simply stopped responding. Not trying to solve the problem anymore. I’m still not getting what I paid for. Terrible, terrible service.

title: 一直跳出購買premium 的頁面
body: 簡單好用，但可以不要每一次開啟app 就跳出要我購買premium 的畫面嗎，我又用不到那些功能我幹嘛買，單純買來去掉那個惱人的premium 廣告嗎？

author: mh.xo

title: 這個顏色跟簡單用法我可以！
body:
用過幾個類似的app，就是這個我一用上手！歡樂的顏色跟簡單易用度是最強的地方！但可惜的是 data sync，如果你同時使用iPhone 跟iPad ，兩者並不是即時自動同步的，而是手動同步到iCloud，然後再從另一台機器挖iCloud 上的資料來同步，如果沒有每一次手動同步，那就會各自紀錄各自的，這個可惜。
除此之外，都很棒！
author: strongstrong

title: Excellent
body: It’s the most customizable habit tracking app I had seen.
author: zhang yuwun

title: Easy to use and easy to track habits
body: I tried several habit tracking apps but I found this one the most customisable and convenient, as it lets you set habit goals by week rather than specific days. For example, my goal was to set up a habit to workout 5 times a week, which was kind of hard to achieve with other apps as most of time tracked goals on a daily basis.

author: tthuang13

title: 美中不足
body:
圖表簡單明瞭又很實用，整體操作沒有遇到問題，很好用的一款習慣養成App，只可惜：
（1）無法更改單位，預設為min，設定次數的目標顯得有點奇怪
（2）如果有長押快速增加次數就好了，現在無論主畫面還是目標的詳細頁面都只能按一次增加一個次數，但像是「每日喝水2000ml」這種目標，一次喝兩三百ml的就會很困擾
author: Lynnette M.
